remarks: Sophisticated townhouse offers in town living with fully fenced yard and attached garage. Just a short distance to the center of town, enjoy New Canaan's great restaurants, boutiques, Playhouse, parks and Metro North train to NYC. This well built 3 story home has newly refinished hardwood floors and quality details like a marble gas fireplace and classic moldings, giving it an elegant tone. Sunny and fresh throughout with custom window treatments and modern lighting for added appeal. The eat in kitchen boasts a bay window, pantry cabinets, newer stainless appliances including gas stove with griddle and French door fridge. Spacious dining room has new Anderson sliders opening to a stone terrace. Enjoy the spacious primary suite that includes a generous walk in closet with custom built ins as well as two additional closets. Luxuriate in the marble bath with double sinks, jetted tub and shower. A nice sized second bedroom has full en-suite bath and laundry area with newer front loaders is on second level. Finished lower level family room/playroom/office space has high ceilings plus great storage. Attached, extra deep garage with additional driveway parking and private, fenced yard create the feel of single family living. Propane heat, up to date systems and wired for Google Home System. Ready for immediate occupancy. Come check out this in town gem.
